inspiration.observed_pattern: JSON_TABLE produces a JSON array column that feeds JSON_OVERLAPS set-intersection evaluation.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored catalog object with one matching label, retaining JSON_TABLE JSON-column projection and JSON_OVERLAPS classification while removing extra objects and labels.

fixture_notes: One fixed catalog object has the target label and must return an overlap flag of 1.
determinism_notes: One literal JSON object and one ordered row; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT jt.item_id, JSON_OVERLAPS(jt.labels, '["featured"]') AS shares_target FROM JSON_TABLE('[{"id":91,"labels":["featured"]}]', '$[*]' COLUMNS (item_id INT PATH '$.id', labels JSON PATH '$.labels')) AS jt ORDER BY jt.item_id
